reason: The two chains use c0*epsilon_X <= c0*W.L*epsilon by multiplying epsilon_X <= W.L*epsilon by c0, but no allowed premise or validated child of this leaf establishes c0 >= 0. The error-improvement external states only c0 < infinity, the root merely chooses a witness, and def-maincb-witness-ledger explicitly supplies no field inequalities. For a negative c0 the multiplication reverses (e.g. epsilon_X=-1 <= 0=W.L*epsilon gives c0*epsilon_X=1 > 0=c0*W.L*epsilon when c0=-1), so both the d_X and reset-unit forwarding chains have a missing sign argument. A separately validated derivation that the chosen witness may be taken nonnegative (or an explicit c0>=0 premise/dependency) is required.
